item.title: Decarbonizing Transport via Multimodal Systems
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on the critical challenge of decarbonizing transport through the development and implementation of multimodal transportation systems. Multimodal transport integration represents a key strategy for achieving substantial reductions in greenhouse gas emissions and improving overall sustainability in the transportation sector.

Potential topics

  • Integration of multiple transport modes to reduce carbon emissions
  • Sustainable mobility solutions and transitions
  • Life cycle assessment of multimodal transport systems
  • Policy frameworks for decarbonizing transport
  • Technology and infrastructure innovations for multimodal systems
  • Behavioral and social aspects of multimodal transport adoption
  • Urban and regional planning for sustainable transport
  • Electric and alternative fuel vehicles in multimodal networks
item.author: Transportation Research Part D: Transport and Environment (ELSEVIER)
